source_evidence: Brokers typically provide investment services on a transactional basis, in which you pay a broker a fee called a commission or markup every time you buy or sell an investment.
answer: Brokers may charge a commission or markup each time you buy or sell an investment. You may also pay other fees and costs for servicing your account or for investments you buy, sell, or hold. Fees and services may be negotiable, but depend on your account agreement, so review it to understand what you may pay.
